title: movement route determined by dice rolls

posts.author: Zelixaps48
posts.body:
Hi everybody, I'm using RPG maker mz and in i would try to know if it's possible to move the player by movement route determined by dice rolls. Visustella plugins  like "Dice Rolls and RNG Seeds VisuStella MZ" allows to create evenement like grahics dice roll, but i don't know if it's possible to create a movement route determined by dice rolls and if it's possible to use dice rolls during battles. There is perhaps a more facility solution to do this. The priority is for the moment the movement route  (I'm using actually for prototyping a map converted by "Tiled visustella plugin).I wouldn't want teleportation but a movement tiles by tiles
If "Tiled plugin" could cause trouble, i could eventually use the RPG maker MZ editor first even if i would preffered conserved this plugin
My project would be to make a very simplified "mario party games style" with batlles evenements and inventory management.
I would really appreciate any assistance with this. Thank you.
​

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You're overthinking this.
The dice rolls part is - to you, the developer - meaningless. All you're asking is "can I do different things based on a random number" and that's the entire point of the Conditional Branch event command.
You make your random number (and use the VisuStella plugin to show the die roll as you like) then just use conditional branches to say "if this is 4, move up" or "if this is 3, move left" or whatever you want to happen.
It has nothing to do with dice or TileD or whatever

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: You would probably have to event each passable tile to check if the dice value is greater than zero, set the player's movement to move in the direction of the next movable tile along the path. You would subtract one from the dice result at every step.

posts.author: Zelixaps48
posts.body: Thank you very much for your very quick responses. I'm going to experiment with this.  This will take a time because I'm not a developer. I'm new to RPG maker MZ, but these are tips that tell me in which direction I should go.
